description: The Carbon Leadership Forum's Whole-Building Life Cycle Assessment Benchmark Study version 2 built on its 2017 Embodied Carbon Benchmark Study to produce a harmonised, high-resolution dataset of WBLCA model results and design characteristics for 292 building projects in the United States and Canada. The project had a pilot phase in 2022 and 2023 to develop and test data collection, then collected and harmonised models, analysed drivers of high and low-carbon projects and published benchmarks and embodied carbon budgets. Outputs include the open-access dataset with a paper, the Embodied Carbon Benchmarks report, a Benchmark Explorer dashboard of box plots by building typology, and a California report on embodied and operational carbon of 30 buildings. Coverage: 292 projects in the United States and Canada. Access: dataset, report and dashboard linked from the CLF page. Licence: open access; dataset licence to be checked on its page. Caveats: projects were submitted by participating firms, so the sample is not random, and LCA tools and scopes were harmonised after the fact. Simulation uses are embodied carbon benchmarks and targets for new buildings and calibration of stock-level embodied carbon models. Related records: EC3 and ÖKOBAUDAT.
